blocks.content: Quiz: Suppose a Student class is derived from a Person class. Then, which of the following statements is correct?
Tap an option below to answer:
The Student class inherits all the variables and functions of the Person class.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the variables and functions of the base class (parent class).
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the variables and functions of the base class (parent class).
Both classes inherit each other's variables and functions.
Only the derived class inherits the base class's variables and functions.
Only the derived class inherits the base class's variables and functions.
The Person class inherits all the variables and functions of the Student class.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the variables and functions of the base class (parent class), not the other way around.
Derived classes (child classes) inherit the variables and functions of the base class (parent class), not the other way around.
One of the answers is correct.
One of the answers is correct.
